profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Electronics and Computer Engineer with more than 5 years of experience in the hardware industry. During my career, I have specialized in designing and developing embedded systems using modular implementation techniques.  As a team member, I have played a supervising role in the deployment of scalable, cost-effective, and reliable solutions. Both during my academic years and my professional career, I have cultivated a spirit of collaboration and a comprehensive set of computational problem-solving skills.

positions.title: Development Engineer
positions.description:
Development Engineer providing hardware and software modular solutions based on embedded systems, for diagnostic reviewing tests for Indupak product:

-- Software development for testing lights, gas emissions and noise pollution, producing embedded software for BeagleBone boards with Debian OS, bash scripting for process monitoring, handling serial communication protocols (which involve the study, analysis and testing of the serial communication protocols of each equipment, using oscilloscopes, custom made serial interfaces and software), and network interfaces, achieving compliance with current technical rules for diagnostic reviewing test of vehicles in Colombia.

-- Hardware and firmware design and development for a dedicated hub, for handling the serial communications between the measuring equipment and the BeagleBone board (based on PIC24F microcontroller)

-- Software, hardware, firmware design, and development for an adjustable digital thermo-hygrometer (based on ATmega128 microcontroller, using commercial sensors and network interfaces, development of a Windows application for adjustment of the sensor, using QtCreator IDE)

positions.title: Development Engineer
positions.description:
Development Engineer providing hardware and software modular solutions for hemodynamic monitoring equipment:

-- Hardware and firmware design and development for an internal blood pressure module (based on PIC16F microcontroller)

-- Software design and development for handling commercial measure cardiac out-put module (AVR based motherboard with Ubuntu)

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Software developer for automation of IR.24 Roaming Protocols:

-- Development of a Windows OS application (using C#) working with GSM 2.0 core nodes (through Ethernet) and cell phones (through AT Modem commands), completing the automation of the IR.24 Roaming Protocol tests.

publications.title: Pollution Spots: A Novel Method For Air Pollution Monitoring
publications.publisher: WIT Transactions on Ecology and the Environment · Jan 1, 2015
